title: Building REST APIs with Express.js
learning_outcomes: Explain the concepts and vocabulary in Building REST APIs with Express.js.
Apply an Express.js 5 pattern from Building REST APIs with Express.js in a focused local example.
Verify normal behavior and at least one error or boundary case using a repeatable test.
